conformance-dangling-object.reason: The Assessment-scoped Test refers to a shared Object that the Assessment does not declare.

conformance-unguarded-input.reason: A presence check dominates the then branch, but the else branch invokes the very same Test when the Input is absent. An Input guard elsewhere in the document is insufficient.

conformance-dependency-version.reason: Within the fixed fixture scope the target has version 1. The dependency explicitly requires version 2.

qualification.scope: The dangling reference diagnostic matches the authoring expectation. The two generic holds do not qualify optional Input dominance or a version mismatch.
